structure.doc: LeafCertClientAuth verifies the client's leaf certificate.

tls.leaf_cert_loader.name: file
tls.leaf_cert_loader.docs: file loads leaf certificates from disk.

tls.leaf_cert_loader.name: folder
tls.leaf_cert_loader.docs:
folder loads certificates and their associated keys from disk
by recursively walking the specified directories, looking for PEM
files which contain both a certificate and a key.

tls.leaf_cert_loader.name: pem
tls.leaf_cert_loader.docs:
pem loads leaf certificates by
decoding their PEM blocks directly. This has the advantage
of not needing to store them on disk at all.

tls.leaf_cert_loader.name: storage
tls.leaf_cert_loader.docs:
storage loads leaf certificates from the
globally configured storage module.
